name: JPMorgan OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund
oneLiner: JLTXX represents JPMorgan's registered government money-market fund shares, with institutional cash redemption and issuer-controlled token balances.
collateral: Fund shares backed by U.S. Treasury securities, overnight repurchase agreements fully collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities and/or cash, and operational cash; JPMorgan Chase Bank is securities custodian and fund accountant.
pegMechanism: The registered government money-market fund seeks a $1 NAV, publishes transaction NAV, and reinvests dividends daily. Eligible registered shareholders redeem cash through Morgan Money, the service center or approved token-burn requests. The off-chain Investor Register determines legal ownership; on-chain balances can temporarily differ.

proofOfReserves.provider: J.P. Morgan Asset Management exact Token Class NAV and class-assets publisher; the SAI names PwC as annual auditor, but no current exact-fund audit report was retrieved

jurisdiction.license: Registered government money-market fund under the Investment Company Act of 1940; a series of JPMorgan Trust IV

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Government money-market fund income distributed through daily dividend reinvestment
